CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (
    id,
    full_name,
    email
  )
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name', ''),
    new.email
  );

  return new;
end;
$function$
